definition.name: NXlaser_pump_probe_hzdr_draco

field.name: experiment_identifier
field.doc: The campaign's experiment_id, the slug LabFrog derives from the campaign name and every HZDR join key uses.

field.name: identifier
field.doc: The shot number. Only the shot authority's number is the shot number; device counters and typed numbers are counts and are never written here.

field.name: time
field.doc: The shot time the shot authority recorded, in UTC.

field.name: status
field.doc: From the LabFrog record of the shot; "shot" when there is none.

field.name: frequency
field.doc: DRACO is usually fired single-shot; DAMNIT fills the rate from the deployment's fixed laser configuration when no producer sends it.

field.name: spot_size
field.doc: DRACO records the focal-spot radius at 1/e^2 intensity (typically 1.5-2.25 um). This is the same quantity as the waist w0 of a PICMI Gaussian laser, so it is compared with simulations unconverted.

field.name: target_type
field.doc: SITE. The target class of HZDR's target ontology. Kept apart from NXsample/type, whose NeXus values (sample, can, buffer...) mean something else.

field.name: target_ref
field.doc: SITE. URL or stable id of the target's record in the HZDR target catalogue (MediaWiki).
